_about: First-run seed for prompts in data/catalog.db; edit prompts in the app (Admin, Prompts), which keeps versions.

prompts.name: tier1.rules
prompts.label: Tier-1 assistant rules
prompts.description: The Tier-1 assistant's system prompt (before the tool list).
required_phrases: Never say a refund has been issued

prompts.name: tier1.error_code_rule
prompts.label: Tier-1 error-code search rule
prompts.description: Inserted into the rules: tells the model to put error codes into its search query.

prompts.name: tier1.prefetch_note
prompts.label: Tier-1 prefetch note
prompts.description: Added when the entitlement check and first search were made by code.

prompts.name: tier1.user_message
prompts.label: Tier-1 ticket message
prompts.description: How a ticket is handed to the model. The ticket text stays between the ticket tags (it is untrusted data).

prompts.name: docs.system
prompts.label: Docs mode system prompt
prompts.description: Rules for Docs mode answers. Traces record its version as v<N> (prompt_version).

prompts.name: docs.refusal
prompts.label: Docs mode refusal message
prompts.description: What Docs mode says when the help centre has no answer. Alerts and traces recognise refusals by its first sentence.

prompts.name: judge.integrated
prompts.label: Tier-1 eval judge (second opinion)
prompts.description: Rubric v3b-integrated for grading Tier-1 replies.

prompts.name: judge.week6_v1
prompts.label: Week 6 judge v1
prompts.description: The first Week 6 judge rubric.

prompts.name: judge.week6_v2
prompts.label: Week 6 judge v2 (validated)
prompts.description: The validated Week 6 rubric; the integrated eval uses it as its primary judge.
required_phrases: Respond with exactly one word: GOOD or NOT_GOOD

prompts.name: week7.system
prompts.label: Week 7 agent system prompt
prompts.description: The Week 7 ticket agent.

prompts.name: week7.freeform
prompts.label: Week 7 agent chat prompt
prompts.description: The Week 7 agent in free-form chat.

prompts.name: week7.workflow
prompts.label: Week 7 fixed workflow prompt
prompts.description: The fixed-workflow baseline in the race.

prompts.name: week7.ticket_not_found
prompts.label: Week 7 workflow: ticket not found reply
prompts.description: Reply when the fixed workflow cannot find the ticket.

prompts.name: week8.mitigation
prompts.label: Week 8 tool-use mitigation
prompts.description: Added to the Week 7 prompt for the trajectory mitigation run.

prompts.name: week8.injection_defense
prompts.label: Week 8 injection defence
prompts.description: Added to the Week 7 prompt for the defended injection run.

prompts.name: eval.second_contact_followup
prompts.label: Second-contact eval: customer follow-up
prompts.description: The simulated customer writing (or not) a follow-up.

prompts.name: eval.second_contact_score
prompts.label: Second-contact eval: scorer
prompts.description: Decides whether the reply already answered the follow-up.

prompts.name: week10.triage
prompts.label: Week 10 triage specialist
prompts.description: Classifies a Docs question and rewrites the search query (multi-agent race).

prompts.name: week10.synthesis
prompts.label: Week 10 orchestrator synthesis
prompts.description: Reviews the specialist's draft against its sources (multi-agent race).

prompts.name: router.classify
prompts.label: Chat router
prompts.description: Picks the assistant or Docs mode for a chat question when the routing rules are unsure.
